Alexander Zverev: World No. 1 Alexander Zverev has experienced a troubled start to his top ranking amid a dismal year for men's tennis, despite being striving for perfection at the ATP Finals in Turin where he has booked the first spot in the semi-finals. Off the court, Zverev received his year-end No. 1 trophy but has faced frustration defending his status, alongside being notified of a fresh lawsuit by his ex-partner Brenda Patea during the tournament.
Carlos Alcaraz: Carlos Alcaraz enters strong form at the ATP Finals in Turin, extending his unbeaten run with group-stage victories over Frances Tiafoe and Flavio Cobolli. He then staged a comeback win against Ben Shelton to reach the championship match, where he is set to face Alexander Zverev for the title.
